reserveReview.rationale: Sygnum identifies each FIUSD as one unit of Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund USD Fund Class G Acc. The official October 9, 2026 USD Fund holdings report, pages 3-4, supplies a complete $10,255,985,140.05 fund-portfolio denominator and six reported security-type percentages totaling 100.01% because of source rounding; the reported weights are retained without normalization. These are dated per-unit look-through fund allocations, not a FIUSD-token-supply-to-held-fund-units reconciliation or token-scoped assurance. The prior October 14 daily workbook observation identifies Class G Acc ISIN IE00BNKLND78, NAV $12,061.69 and 1,518.17 outstanding share-class units. The prior October 15 native token census is 1,517.66 zkSync plus zero Arbitrum units; a whole-share-class total does not identify Sygnum's fiduciary holdings or explain the 0.51-unit difference. Those observations retain their original dates and were not renewed by the portfolio refresh. Neither source is the separate Fidelity USD Treasury Fund, a liquidity guarantee or a token-level recovery contract. Existing medium risk classifications and manual-review confidence are retained; issuer-specific exposure, whole-position liquidation and contractual maturity maxima are not inferred from aggregate categories, WAM, or WAL. Since 2026-10-24 the live chainlink-nav feed uses navScope native-fund-share (one Class G Acc unit per token), so the reviewed reserve is the single keyed fund-share row; the October 9 look-through allocation is retained here, not as slices: cash 1.55%, certificates of deposit 36.3%, commercial paper 35.4%, corporate bonds 10.29%, repurchase agreements 3.9%, time deposits 12.57% (sums to 100.01% from source rounding).
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact FIUSD Class G fund-unit claim; dated full USD Fund portfolio security-type allocation, without token-unit reconciliation or assurance inference
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The dated October 9 Fidelity USD Fund report classifies all six security types, so zero here means no unclassified underlying-fund category, not zero token-level uncertainty. Exact current FIUSD fiduciary unit-to-token attribution, custody/subcustody allocation and executable liquidity remain unresolved. The source review retrieved the new official holdings report and re-read Sygnum's issuer application and current tokenization page on 2026-10-20. The current page still identifies FIUSD separately from the newer FILQ product; FILQ Ethereum liquidity and custody claims do not establish exact tracked-FIUSD unit attribution. The prior October 14 workbook and October 15 RPC observations remain historical, not a refreshed token-to-unit reconciliation. Parse the USD fund section, not GBP/EUR or USD Treasury funds. The live feed is a native fund-share claim (navScope native-fund-share) keyed to the single fund-share row; preserve the existing 48-hour source/fetch fallback; the historical issuer application describes monthly holdings publication but does not establish the current cadence.
